records.text: Back build (viewer handle; spelling unverified) writes, thank you for teaching us to believe our eyes and not the experts. My dog was almost put down because the expert vet said there was no hope for her, but Daisy (commenter's dog) was still walking around energetic.
records.speaker: Candace Owens

appearances.snippet: Back build (viewer handle; spelling unverified) writes, thank you for teaching us to believe our eyes and not the experts. My dog was almost put down because the expert vet said there was no hope for her, but Daisy (commenter's dog) was still walking around energetic.

records.text: I said no, gave her a chance and now she is getting well. Thank you. Yes, I teach you to trust your own instincts, not to trust people telling you what you need to believe and demonstrating authority that they don't have.
records.speaker: Candace Owens
